def:
SELECT mm.local_id
   FROM (ministry_members mm
     JOIN ministries m ON ((m.id = mm.ministry_id)))
  WHERE ((mm.profile_id = auth.uid()) AND (m.name = 'Local Finance Ministry'::text) AND (mm.local_id IS NOT NULL));
name: my_finance_locals
